fine_lines.title: mouse vs mice
fine_lines.explanation_ar: mouse فأر واحد، و mice فئران (جمع غير منتظم).
fine_lines.explanation_en: One mouse, two mice. "mice" is an irregular plural.

examples.sentence: A mouse sat on his belt.

fine_lines.title: scared vs scary
fine_lines.explanation_ar: scared = خائف (شعور)، و scary = مخيف (صفة للشيء).

expressions.phrase: What am I going to do?
expressions.meaning_en: Said when you have a problem.
expressions.example: The crows took my straw! What am I going to do?
You have a problem? I can help.

expressions.phrase: That is very kind of you.
expressions.example: I can carry your bag. - That is very kind of you.

expressions.meaning_en: Saying you know a way to solve a problem.
expressions.example: I have an idea! Let's ask Mum.

grammar.title: Past simple: irregular verbs
grammar.explanation_ar: بعض الأفعال لها ماضٍ غير منتظم: fly → flew، take → took، steal → stole، say → said.
grammar.explanation_en: Some verbs have an irregular past: fly → flew, take → took, steal → stole, say → said.
examples: The crow flew to the scarecrow.

grammar.title: can for help and ability
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم can + فعل للقدرة أو لعرض المساعدة: I can help. ونستخدم can't لعدم القدرة.
grammar.explanation_en: Use can + verb for ability or to offer help. can't = not able.
examples: I can scare the crows away.

questions.question: Why did the crows take the straw?
questions.explanation_en: They used it for their nests.

questions.question: One mouse, twenty ___.
questions.explanation_en: The plural of mouse is mice.

questions.question: The crow ___ to the scarecrow. (fly, past)
questions.explanation_en: The past of fly is flew.

questions.question: What did the mice want as a gift?
questions.explanation_en: They wanted to live in his pockets.

questions.question: Someone helps you. You say: ___
choices: What am I going to do?
That is very kind of you.
questions.explanation_ar: نشكر بقول That is very kind of you.
questions.explanation_en: Say "That is very kind of you."

questions.question: The crow was afraid. He was ___.
"steal" means ___.
questions.explanation_en: steal = take what is not yours.
